instruction: Set the tab size to 2 and show all whitespace characters in VS Code.

metadata.task_rationale: Tests multi-setting configuration requiring two changes. Slightly harder than single-setting tasks, leveraging the model's demonstrated ability to navigate and modify VS Code settings through multiple approaches.
